results.name: Modern Coastal Hillside Villa
results.description:
Cliffside Horizon Villa is a modern luxury residence designed on a sloped coastal landscape, combining clean architectural volumes with natural stone elements and expansive glass facades. The villa features a dramatic double-height entrance, panoramic terraces, a spacious outdoor pool area, and seamless indoor-outdoor living spaces.

Built around the harmony of geometry and nature, the design integrates stone retaining walls, elevated pathways, mature landscaping, and carefully positioned viewpoints overlooking the surrounding scenery. Large floor-to-ceiling windows maximize natural light while creating a strong visual connection between the interior and the environment.

This project focuses on contemporary architectural aesthetics, realistic materials, and a balanced composition of stone, glass, concrete, and wood. The result is a sophisticated hillside retreat that blends modern luxury with natural surroundings.

Software: Blender
Category: Architectural Visualization / Residential Architecture

results.name: Squid Game Lobby
results.description:
This 3D model is a detailed recreation of the lobby room from Squid Game, where players wait before entering the games. The room has octagonal shape with white brick walls, a concrete floor, and blue upper walls.

There are red and blue floor markings for voting, a large black screen, and an arched doorway which is where the guards enter in the show. The ceiling is filled with bright lights.

Perfect for Roblox game projects or animations based on Squid Game.

Please note that this is not an official model and is not directly affiliated with Squid Game, Netflix, or it's creators.

Don't forget to like model and check out my other Squid Game models!

Check out my website: https://codepen.io/DodoBabypop/full/myejLBQ

results.name: Tropical Modernity in Philippines
results.description:
Nestled in the upscale neighborhood of Ayala Alabang, a modern 2-storey house strikes a balance between nature and architectural finesse. A blend of concrete and warm woodwork frames the exterior, topped by a pitch-roofline that adds character and a modern tropical flair.

The ground floor presents a sophisticated design with ample windows that allow natural light, while maintaining privacy. The heart of the home, the kitchen, extends outward to a wooden deck, merging indoor dining with the beautiful outdoors.

The second floor, dotted with large windows, offers scenic views of the tropical landscape, while the master suite features a private balcony for moments of serenity. The house is solar-panel-ready, aligning with eco-friendly living ideals.

The driveway, flanked by lush tropical plants, winds up to an integrated garage, seamlessly designed as part of the house. This model is a testament to modern living, offering a blend of design, functionality, and sustainability.

results.name: The Milwaukee Breakwater Lighthouse - Wisconsin
results.description:
Scanned by Senior HPI Researcher John Everitt. 

This lighthouse, owned and operated by the United States Coast Guard, is an active aid to navigation. The steel tower has a square Balcony and "round cast iron lantern room that features helical astragals" in the lantern. The two-story steel lighthouse keeper's quarters are in the art deco style. The structure rests on a 60 by 54 feet (18 by 16 m) concrete pier, which rises more than 20 feet (6.1 m) above the lake's surface. The tower rests 14 feet (4.3 m) above the second floor and is 53 feet (16 m) tall overall. The red light has a focal plane of 67 feet (20 m) feet above Lake Michigan." -Wikipedia

Created in RealityCapture by Capturing Reality from 1472 images.
